'''Coleraine Football Club''' is a [[Northern Ireland|Northern Irish]] [[association football|football]] club, playing in the [[NIFL Premiership]], the highest level of the [[Northern Ireland Football League]].

The club, founded in 1927, hails from [[Coleraine]], [[County Londonderry]], and plays its home matches at [[The Showgrounds (Coleraine)|The Showgrounds]]. Club colours are blue and white. The club won the [[Northern Ireland Football League|Irish League]] title once (in [[1973–74 Irish League|1973–74]]) and the [[Irish Cup]] on seven occasions, most recently in 2025–26. They are also the only Irish League club to have won two successive all-Ireland competitions, lifting the [[Blaxnit Cup]] in 1969 and 1970. The club share a rivalry with [[Ballymena United F.C.|Ballymena United]]."}}
